title: Shared definitions for insurance-risk-compliance skill schemas
description: Shared $defs that per-skill schemas in this plugin commonly redefine. Per-skill schemas should $ref these via "../_defs.json#/$defs/<name>" rather than redefining the same enums and shapes inline. Plugin-specific extras (insurance_regulator_enum, insurance_line_of_business_enum, orsa_section_enum) sit alongside the base definitions.

severity_enum_with_moderate.description: Variant ladder used by state DOI exam findings and NAIC accreditation reports where 'moderate' has settled meaning.

confidence_label.description: Author confidence in the artifact as a whole.

owner_role.description: Named firm function or role with accountability (e.g., 'Chief Risk Officer', 'Chief Actuary', 'Chief Compliance Officer', 'Appointed Actuary', 'Chief Underwriting Officer', 'Head of Market Conduct'). Never an individual person.

human_review_gate.description: Embedded human-review-gate descriptor. Common insurance gates: ORSA summary report board adoption, market-conduct exam response sign-off, appointed-actuary opinion review, NAIC AI Model Bulletin governance committee approval.

insurance_regulator_enum.description: Primary or relevant insurance regulator. State-DOI is used for the lead-state regulator; multiple-state filings carry the lead state in a separate field. NAIC is the standards-setter, not a direct regulator; use it where the artifact addresses model laws or accreditation standards.

insurance_line_of_business_enum.description: Insurance line of business the artifact addresses. Drives applicability of model laws, market-conduct expectations, and reserving methodology.

orsa_section_enum.description: Section of the ORSA Summary Report the artifact maps to. Used by orsa-readiness and risk-committee artifacts in this plugin.
